title: Havel--Hakimi Residues of Common-Divisor Graphs: Complete Asymptotics and Prime-Counting Structure
summary: Let $G_n$ be the graph on $\{2,\ldots,n\}$ in which two integers are adjacent when they have a common divisor greater than one. We determine the complete asymptotic expansion of its Havel--Hakimi residue $\R(G_n)$, confirming a leading-constant prediction of Staton recorded in Fajtlowicz's \emph{Written on the Wall}. If $A=\sum_{k=2}^{\infty}(\log k)/(k^2(k-1))$, then the first two terms are $\R(G_n)=(ζ(2)-1)n/\log n+(ζ(2)-1-A)n/\log^2n +O(n/\log^3n)$.
